newFactsLearned.fact: The combination of updated dependency versions (commons-fileupload:1.6.0, commons-text:1.10.0, log4j-core:2.17.0, json:20231013, snakeyaml:2.0, commons-io:2.14.0) caused a Maven build failure.

recommendedFocusForPlanner: Review the Maven build log (attempt-1/build.log) to understand the nature of the build failure (e.g., compilation errors, missing classes, incompatible APIs).
Investigate if any of the new dependency versions introduce breaking changes or require specific Java Development Kit (JDK) versions or framework upgrades.
Consider isolating the dependency upgrades to determine which specific change(s) led to the build failure.
If the build failure points to major API incompatibilities, classify the relevant vulnerabilities for manual review requiring broader code changes or framework migrations.

whatChanged.summary: All 6 intended patches, including dependency version updates and one dependency management override, were successfully applied to pom.xml.

whatHappened.failureSummary: Maven build failed after the application of the remediation patches.

whatWeTried.summary: Attempted to update versions for multiple vulnerable Maven dependencies, including one dependency management override, based on the patch plan.
